game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Harbor Docks, busy wooden harbor docks: the sailor must handle rogue crabs while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Gatekeeper If: Write a single if condition that opens the gate only for friendly visitors.
theme: Coastal Port – Harbor Docks: busy wooden harbor docks
core_gameplay_loop: In Harbor Docks, repeat each round: Write a single if condition that opens the gate only for friendly visitors. Each round, rogue crabs strike the cargo hold, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the gate_integrity value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the cargo hold from rogue crabs in Harbor Docks: keep the gate_integrity meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: gate_integrity drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 1 (intro tier): Gatekeeper If
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Gatekeeper If' (Week 3 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Harbor Docks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gate_integrity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crabs in Harbor Docks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while gate_integrity > 0.
